body:
Data-drove apps2/mud's hardcoded dropsForMob switch into server/mobdrop.Registry (data/mob_drops.json), backfilled real drop tables for every mob kind that previously fell through to the generic Flow default. Shipped IDUNA /admin/gfd-mob-drops (list/create/edit/delete, keyed by mob Kind, same direct-file-access precedent as /admin/gfd-items). 15 new tests total across both repos, all passing. Live-verified: restarted production apps2/mud (zero active connections first) and real IDUNA, killed a real worm in-game -- correct drops. Commits: GoblinFoxDragon 0317804, IDUNA 28a6bf5. Real, honest limitation named in both: drop tables key on mob Kind only, not (Kind, zone) -- matches the S251-06 vendor-catalog gap.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-MD-001: mob drops manager shipped (data-driven registry + IDUNA admin GUI)
